responsibilities: Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data-products to enable data-informed decision-making.
Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business.
Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core.
Harmonize data across manufacturing sites, software, and platforms for enterprise-level consumption.
Designing highly organized and scalable architectural solutions to drive efficiency.
Define orchestration strategies across multiple data domains.
Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement.
Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code.
Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on-time.
Focus on innovative solutions to increase speed-to-delivery and accelerate business decision-making.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: documentation, testing, governance and accuracy language recur across the responsibilities — 'a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement' — against a single speed bullet.
evidence.domain_risk: This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High: this is pharmaceutical manufacturing data at Bristol Myers Squibb, with the role summary naming 'quality, and governance' as its focus and a governed metadata framework as a delivery constraint.
evidence.collaboration_width: No partner teams are named — the JD refers only to 'the business', 'stakeholders' and 'internal consumers'.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mature: a governed metadata framework, an analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks are already deployed, and the role works inside them rather than defining them.
evidence.jd_authorship: The ideal candidate will have experience designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions across multiple subject areas.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring manager: the JD names specific modelling techniques (SCD, conformed dimensions, star/snowflake schemas) and specific engineering practice (DAG-based and asset-based pipeline design, DRY dbt code).
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: while also enabling self-service analytics across the organization
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: internal_data: the deliverable is a centralised data layer and self-service analytics for 'internal consumers', not a named business function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Define orchestration strategies across multiple data domains.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: the role architects the core data layer ('Define orchestration strategies', 'Designing highly organized and scalable architectural solutions') while working inside a governance framework it does not own.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: no AI, LLM or AI-tooling language appears in the responsibilities or qualifications.
evidence.testing_framing: Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: tested, documented code is a delivery obligation stated in the responsibilities section, reinforced by 'Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data'.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: quality and governance are named in the role summary itself, and documentation is framed as a delivery requirement rather than a nicety — the fear is ungoverned data in a regulated manufacturer.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: the role builds a new centralised data layer while also consolidating what already exists — 'Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core' and 'Harmonize data across manufacturing sites'.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing runs through the responsibilities as governance obligations: 'Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement' and 'Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on-time.'
